This list comes from the project docs (`docs/flows/add-endpoint.md`, which uses "rest at the inn" as its example, plus the types, index and frontend service docs). I haven't opened any code files, so the line numbers are from the docs' anchors.

## Worker

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `worker/src/types/index.ts` | Add `RestBody { sessionId, characterId }` next to the other `*Body` types (around `ShopTransactionBody:159`). Add a cost constant such as `INN_REST_COST`. |
| `worker/src/routes/rest.ts` (new) | Export `restRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>()` with `POST /`. It validates the body and loads the character with `getCharacter`. It rejects the request if `gold < cost` or `hp === max_hp`. Then it calls `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: max_hp, gold: gold - cost })` (`services/character.ts:94`). It returns `{ updatedCharacter }`. Optionally it adds `askDM` narration, `appendHistory` and `saveSession`, and an `adventure_log` insert, following `routes/action.ts`. |
| `worker/src/index.ts` | Import `restRoutes` and add `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes)` in the route mounts (`:41-48`). CORS needs no change. |
| `worker/src/services/*.ts` | Only needed if the logic is shared with another route. Otherwise keep it in the route. |
| `worker/migrations/` | None. `hp`, `max_hp` and `gold` already exist on `characters`, so there's no schema change. |

The Worker should calculate the cost and the HP restored. The AI only narrates.

## Frontend

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts` | Add a `RestResponse` interface (`updatedCharacter`, plus a narrative if you add one). Mirror any new Worker type by hand, since nothing enforces the two copies matching. |
| `frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts` | Add `rest(sessionId, characterId)` that posts to `${API_BASE}/api/rest`. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts` | Add a `restAtInn()` handler. It calls `GameApiService.rest`, then `CharacterStateService.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)`. It pushes a system or narrative entry and shows `err.error.error` on failure (for example, not enough gold). |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html` | Add a "Rest at Inn" button near the Inventory button (`:9`). Disable it during combat (`inCombat`) and when HP is full. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.spec.ts` | Add tests with `GameApiService` as a Jasmine spy: success, insufficient gold, and the button disabled in combat. |

`CharacterStateService` needs no code change. `setCharacter()` already updates the sheet and the HP bar.

## Docs to update in the same change
- The doc beside each changed file, and a new `routes/rest.md`.
- `code.md`, then re-run `research-work/scripts/build-symbol-index.mjs`.
- `docs/PRD.md` §9 (API spec) and `worker/src/index.md` (route mounts table).
- `docs/flows/` if you want a dedicated rest flow doc.

## Things to check
- **Resting during combat:** the docs don't say whether the Worker should block it. I'd have `routes/rest.ts` read the session's `CombatState` and reject the request while combat is active. I haven't confirmed how the combat state is stored.
- **Potion healing bug:** potion healing only changes HP locally and is never saved (B-05). Rest won't have this problem because it saves through `updateCharacter`.
